prompt.en: Which country became a partner in the North American Free Trade Agreement in 1994?
prompt.fr: Quel pays est devenu partenaire de l'Accord de libre-échange nord-américain en 1994?

explanation.en: Mexico joined Canada and the United States in 1994. The guide calls the result the broader North American Free Trade Agreement.
explanation.fr: Le Mexique s'est joint au Canada et aux États-Unis en 1994. Le guide parle alors de l'Accord de libre-échange nord-américain, plus large.

source.quote: Mexico became a partner in 1994 in the broader North American Free Trade Agreement (NAFTA)
